kit.title: Synthetic voice: one source change at a time
kit.note: The same short phrase, five pairs. In each pair only one thing about the voice's sound source differs. Tell us what you hear in the voice itself: buzz, edge, kazoo, breath, hiss. There are no wrong answers; 'no difference' is a real answer.

clips.title: Measured: HNR 30.3 dB, output rms 0.0537, peak 0.227. Scaffold source: band-limited saw through the tilt lowpass.
clips.feel: the short made-up phrase 'ah-mee' in a synthetic voice; listen to the voice itself (buzz, edge, breath), not the words

clips.title: Measured: HNR 29.5 dB, output rms 0.0401 (-2.5 dB re saw), peak 0.102 (-6.9 dB). Band energy re total, 0-0.5/0.5-1.5/1.5-3/3-6 kHz, from the render before the tract fix (a different FFT estimate on the new render differs by under 1 dB; not re-measured with the original method): saw -2.3/-4.0/-24.0/-24.9 dB, Rosenberg -0.3/-12.4/-43.7/-40.3 dB. PREDICTION: darker and rounder than the saw, less buzz and edge, F2 of /i/ weaker; loudness the same (that last part is already falsified at the output: it is 2.5 dB quieter). FALSIFIED if no difference is heard, if it is heard as buzzier or brighter, or if it is heard as the same kazoo quality.
clips.feel: the short made-up phrase 'ah-mee' in a synthetic voice; listen to the voice itself (buzz, edge, breath), not the words

clips.title: Measured: HNR 19.9 dB, output rms 0.0539, peak 0.242. White glottal noise raised to 0.33. PREDICTION: audible breath/hiss under the voice; a listener who called the clean voice a kazoo or buzzer hears this as less pure-tone but still a machine. FALSIFIED if B is not noisier; if the noise is heard as a separate hiss stream not fused with the voice; or if A and B are the same kazoo to the same degree (then purity of the periodicity is not what makes it a kazoo).
